assertions.text: Table columns represent the method's public inputs (applicant type, age, claim count) and observable outputs (decision, premium)
assertions.evidence: Columns: 'Applicant type', 'Age', 'Claims' (inputs) and 'Status?', 'Premium?' (outputs). No internal fields.

assertions.text: No column is named after private fields or internal variables (hasActivePolicy, internalRiskScore, riskScore)
assertions.evidence: Column names: Scenario, Applicant type, Age, Claims, Status?, Premium?. None reference private fields.

assertions.text: Table has a scenario/description column as the leftmost column
Column names use domain/business language, not code identifiers
assertions.evidence: 'Applicant type', 'Age', 'Claims', 'Status?', 'Premium?' use business language, not applicantType/claimCount.

assertions.text: Scenario names describe conditions, not outcomes
assertions.evidence: 'Renewal, no claims', 'High risk', 'Senior, within risk threshold' describe conditions, not outcomes.

assertions.text: Table has at least one column name ending with '?'
Test method body contains no if or switch statements
assertions.evidence: Method contains only: result assignment, assertEquals(status...), assertEquals(premium...). No conditionals.

assertions.text: Test method has a descriptive @DisplayName or method name
If @Description is present and text is long, uses text block (triple-quotes), not string concatenation
assertions.evidence: @Description uses triple-quoted string """...""" for multiline text

assertions.text: Multiple tables address distinct concerns (or acceptable if domain genuinely has single concern)
assertions.evidence: Single @TableTest mixes decision logic (AUTO_APPROVED/REJECTED) and premium calculation. These are distinct concerns, requiring separation.

assertions.text: Each table has only the rows needed to express its concern's rules
assertions.evidence: 7 rows collectively cover AUTO_APPROVED path, RENEWAL variants, risk scoring, senior/standard premiums—minimal for these concerns

assertions.text: Decision logic and premium calculation are in separate @TableTest methods
assertions.evidence: Single method tests both 'Status?' (decision) and 'Premium?' (premium) in same @TableTest
